_provenance.source: re-parse of census-ALL.csv (2026-08-27 06:42 sweep) with the qualifier fields restored

job_definition.why: the 2026-08-29 census counted every extension, so a .lst, a .log, a .pdf and a .sas7bdat each counted as evidence that a study runs a job of that type

_provenance.identifiers: counts only. No path, study name, filename stem or patient identifier leaves this script. qualifier1 values DO include generic clinical variable names (echo, afib, lvmassi) under distributions, because that is the finding: the qualifier is a variable there. They are shared clinical vocabulary, not study-specific.
_provenance.qualifier1_is_positional: it is an outcome in analyses, a table type in descriptive, a clinical variable in distributions and a mix in graphs. See the design note; do not name it in one word.
